A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 7-substituted indoles are the most reactive of the three isomeric 6-aminoindoles, and that 6-amino indole itself is the least reactive of the three.
the 6-aminoindole derivatives are not as reactive toward acetoacetic ester as are the corresponding 3-aminobenzofuran derivatives.
the reactivity of 6-amines of the indole series depends on the nature of the 2-substituent and the solvent used for the reaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reactivity of the 6-aminoindoles depends on the nature of the substituent in the 7-position.
the 6-aminoindole is a very versatile starting material for the synthesis of a variety of pyrroloquinolines.
6-aminoindole derivatives are more reactive towards enolates of acetoacetic ester than 6-aminoquinoline.
